prompt: Close on the brass letterbox of a front door from inside the hall: a hand pushing a bunch of house keys through it from outside, the keys about to drop onto a doormat already covered in unopened letters, the hall behind empty of furniture. Winter dusk in a near-future Britain, cold blue-grey light, the only warm colour the small orange fires of braziers and camping stoves; photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, deep shadows that stay dark, no lens flare, no bloom, no teal-orange grade. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no signs, banners, logos, number plates or screen text. No children.
